The game's first instruction, where the tape loader hands over: interrupts off, stack reset, CIA 1 port directions set for the joystick and keyboard, $51 cleared, then the NMI, RESET and IRQ vectors at $FFFA-$FFFF pointed at $3A0C (an RTI), $39ED and $3A0D, and $0314 at $3A0D too. CIA 2 selects video bank 3 ($C000-$FFFF), and $01 is written $35, which leaves only I/O over the RAM. It goes on to clear the score $42-$44 and the flags $53 and $37, run the Hall of Fame prank at $226A, and runs into the title loop, which sets six lives at $08C0.

At the hand-over this is JSR $4108, which builds the object-type tables; the next two instructions turn its opcode into $AD (LDA), so the call happens once and the instruction does nothing afterwards.

The loop the game comes back to after a game (game_start runs into it the first time): clears the screens ($29C2), colours the score line, clears the climbing flag, the shown counters and the bonus, sets $30 to $FF and six lives, shows the Hall of Fame ($1E8A), clears the score, waits for fire on control port 2 ($26DA), shows the title ($276C), clears the top line of the screen at $C000 and plays from $0924. When that returns, the game over, it blanks the screen, silences all three SID voices, sets the volume to 15, shows GAME OVER ($26EC) and starts again with the JMP at $091A.
